name: DW World Title
notes: Named on the federation's own title-history index, which linked a page for it that was never captured.
epitaph: The federation listed it first of three and built it a page. Nobody ever crawled that page, no champion of it is named anywhere in what survives, and both of the cards the fed announced are ordinary matches with no title on the line.

name: DW Tag Team Titles
notes: Named on the federation's own title-history index; its own page was never captured.
epitaph: A federation whose largest roster ran to nine names still kept a set of tag team championships on its own title-history index. No team is recorded as having held them, and neither of its announced cards carries a tag match.

name: DW Hardcore Title
notes: Named on the federation's own title-history index; its own page was never captured.
epitaph: The third of the three belts the federation listed for itself. Its own hardcore page was captured as a bare shell with no body text at all, and no holder of the championship survives.
